fields.title: Model / image / creator / tag record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Civitai's own official API JSON shape. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). "models"/"model-detail" records carry the full upstream model object verbatim (id, name, type, stats, creator, tags, and a nested modelVersions array with files/download URLs/images). "images" records carry the upstream image object verbatim (meta is always null on the public API -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md). "creators"/"tags" records carry the upstream listing object verbatim.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search query, model ID, or descriptor that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-api, or none on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. model_not_found, invalid_request).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

id.title: ID
id.description: Upstream numeric ID -- a model, image, or post ID depending on mode.

type.title: Type
type.description: Models mode -- Checkpoint / LORA / TextualInversion / etc.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: Models/images mode -- download/like/comment counts, nested object, passed through as-is.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Models mode -- {username, image}, passed through as-is.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Models mode -- list of tag name strings.

modelVersions.title: Model versions
modelVersions.description: Models/model-detail mode -- full nested array of every version, each with files (download URLs, hashes, virus-scan results) and sample images, passed through as-is.

url.title: Image URL
url.description: Images mode -- the CDN URL of the image.

meta.title: Generation metadata
meta.description: Images mode -- always null on the public API regardless of the image's own hasMeta flag; this is Civitai's own privacy restriction, not a bug. See CRAWLING_METHOD.md.

modelCount.title: Model count
modelCount.description: Creators mode -- how many models this user has published.

link.title: API link
link.description: Creators/tags mode -- a ready-to-use /models?... filter link for this creator or tag.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across model / image / creator / tag records.
